name: AE Employer Election Operational Dashboard
description: Working-team dashboard for Annual Enrollment: non-completed status detail (by region), stalled-time buckets, multiple-attempts/recent-completion activity, election-type/HSA breakdowns, and a daily timeline. Split off from AE Snap Report on 2026-09-13.

feeds.description: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year — same shape as AE Snap Report's employerStatus binding (both widgets share AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY); Election Sub-Type also carries the 3 new operational row-kinds (Multiple Attempts / Stalled .../Days / Recently Completed)

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
